title: Remove 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution from footer

requirements.text: Remove the 'Built with caffeine.ai' (or 'Built with love using caffeine.ai') attribution text and any associated elements from the Footer component so it no longer appears on any page.

quotes: Remove the Built with love using caffeine.ai section at the footer of all pages

acceptanceCriteria: The Footer component no longer renders any text or link referencing 'caffeine.ai' or 'Built with love'.
All pages that include the Footer (LandingPage, AdminDashboard, ApiReferencePage) show no such attribution.
No other footer content (brand logo, navigation links, trading disclaimer, copyright) is altered.

constraints: Only remove the caffeine.ai attribution; do not modify any other footer content.
nonGoals: Redesigning or restructuring the footer layout.
Changing any other page sections or components.
